title: Intervention Geometry Shapes Apparent Positional-Encoding Robustness in Vision Transformers: Replication Package
description: Frozen replication release for the Neural Networks manuscript 'Intervention Geometry Shapes Apparent Positional-Encoding Robustness in Vision Transformers'. The release preserves the scientific master, frozen protocols, executed selector-replication and ALiBi slope-assignment evidence, sensitivity analyses, checkpoint/sample provenance, SHA-256 manifests, and the final Main/Supplement submission source layer. The repository contains mixed scholarly materials; see LICENSE_SCOPE.md for file-level licensing.
